source.attribution: Formation samples derived from HELIOS Base (https://github.com/helios-base/helios-base), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2021 HELIOS Base. Converted to app coordinates and edited.
source.note: Only this data file is used. The HELIOS C++ sources carry GPL/LGPL headers and no code from them is used; the interpolation in js/engine/formation.js is written from scratch after Akiyama and Noda (2008).
source.conversion: x = x_h + 52.5, y = y_h + 34 (no y flip: HELIOS L roles are at negative y = our left); roles via HELIOS_ROLE in js/engine/roles.js; rounded to 0.01 m; samples[i] is HELIOS sample index i. Ball points outside the pitch are kept: they make the triangulation cover the whole pitch.
